Наведи запрос на чашку: Aim the query at the cup
Запрос — толстая оранжевая стрелка на пл: The query is the thick orange arrow on the key plane. Each object gets a score q·k, the dot product of the query and its key. Softmax turns the scores into weights that sum to 1. Rotate and stretch the query so that the cup gets more than half of the attention.
Скалярное произведение больше, когда стр: The dot product is larger when the arrows point the same way. Point the query along the cup's key and make it longer.
The cup got more than half of the attention. Its weight depends on all the keys at once: softmax normalizes the whole row, and the neighboring keys, the kettle's and the bowl's, take part of the weight. The query length works like sharpness: the longer the arrow, the bigger the difference between the scores and the sharper the peak.
An object's value is its location on the table. The attention output is a weighted sum of values, so the output is a point on the table, shown by the crosshair. Find a query for which the output lands on an empty spot: more than 15 cm from any object.
Ответ дальше 15 см от всех предметов: Output more than 15 cm from every object
Если запрос совсем короткий, веса почти: If the query is very short, the weights are almost equal and the output lands at the middle of the table, where the sugar bowl stands. Turn the query between the keys of two objects that stand far apart on the table.
Ответ лёг на пустое место стола. Выход в: The output landed on an empty spot of the table. The attention output is a weighted sum of values. When the weights are spread out, the output ends up between the objects, where there's nothing. It's the same averaging as with regression in lesson 1.3: the average of two correct answers can itself be wrong.
К двум видимым компонентам ключей и запр: Let's add hidden components to the two visible components of the keys and the query: random numbers with variance 1. The total number of components is set by d_k: in the 2017 transformer d_k = 64, in the language model inside π0 it's 256. We leave the query alone in this mission. The experiment grows d_k from 2 to 256. Then make the largest weight drop below 0.9 at d_k = 256.
что станет с весами при d_k = 256 без де: what happens to the weights at d_k = 256 without division?
Веса схлопнулись в один пик: у предмета: The weights collapsed into one peak: the ${ITEM(r.arg).name} gets ${fmt2(r.max)}, the rest almost zero. The q·k scores range from ${fmt(r.lo, 0)} to ${fmt(r.hi, 0)}, and softmax of such numbers picks just one. Leave the query alone: find the knob that brings the scores back into a working range, and run the experiment again.
Переключи столбики на q·k: оценки выросл: Switch the bars to q·k: the scores have grown tens of times. Turn on division by √d_k.
The largest weight is ${fmt2(r.max)}. With independent components of variance 1, the variance of q·k equals d_k: at d_k = 256 the scores spread by about ±16, and softmax of such numbers almost always gives a single peak. In training this means near-zero gradients (quiz question 2). Dividing by √256 = 16 brings the spread back to one. Our hidden components are random, so after division the weights barely depend on the query. In a trained model all 256 components carry meaning, and the division keeps the scores in a working range.
Маска решает, кто кого видит: закрытая к: The mask decides who sees whom: a closed cell sets the score to −∞, and softmax gives it weight 0. Take six tokens in π0's order: frames from two cameras and the command, then the state, then two actions. Build a mask that meets four conditions.

Это блочная маска π0. Так же устроена pr: This is π0's block mask. The prefix-LM in PaliGemma (lesson 3.2) works the same way: within a block attention goes both ways, between blocks only backward. The frames and the command see neither the state nor the actions, so their K and V don't change while the model refines the actions. They are computed once and put in the cache. We'll come back to this in the section on the KV cache.
У каждой головы своя матрица ключей. Гол: Each head has its own key matrix. The “color” head sees only color, the “location” head only where an object stands. The cup is red and stands at the front edge. But in the “color” head its key coincides with the kettle's, and in the “location” head with the bowl's. Tune both heads so that the cup comes out on top in both. You switch heads above the key plane.

Каждая голова по отдельности путает чашк: Each head on its own confuses the cup: “color” splits attention between the cup and the kettle, “location” between the cup and the bowl. The head outputs are concatenated and passed through the matrix W^O, and together they name the cup unambiguously. Each head's width is d_model/h, so eight heads cost almost as much as one full-width head (quiz question 3).

Поменяй местами «чашку» и «миску». Смотр: Swap “cup” and “bowl”. Watch the weights under the words: without positions each word carries its weight along.
Без позиций каждое слово уносит свой вес: Without positions each word carries its weight along: a permutation changes neither the word weights nor the attention output. Attention by itself doesn't know order: there's no recurrence and no convolution in it. Sinusoids of different frequencies give each position its own vector, and the query “what to take first” now sees which word is closer to the start. Failures found without positions: ${st.fails.size} of 12 possible. In ACT the image positions are 2D sinusoids, in Gemma it's RoPE. In the 2017 paper, learned positions gave almost the same result as sinusoids.

Каждая клетка — косинусное сходство коди: Each cell is the cosine similarity of the encodings of two positions, 16 numbers per position. The diagonal and the cells next to it are the brightest: neighboring positions are similar and distant ones less so, which is why the same word in different places gets different vectors. The frame marks positions 0–3, where the command sits. Hover over a cell.

что станет с выводом без KV-кэша?: what happens to inference without the KV cache?

Нажми на полосу у границы между проходом: Click the bar near the boundary between the pass over the observation and the flow steps: the cursor will snap to it. On the tape, look for the tick where the color changes.
До первого шага flow проходит 46 мс из 7: Before the first flow step, 46 ms of the 73 go by: the image encoders (14 ms) and the pass over the observation (32 ms). Then 10 flow steps of 51 tokens each read the ready K and V of the prefix and take 27 ms for all steps. Without the cache, every step would run the 816 observation tokens again: by our estimate 361 ms, five times longer. A new chunk starts every 25 ticks, that is, once every 0.5 s, while the robot gets an action every 20 ms. So the control rate, 50 Hz, is not the same as the inference rate: the model is called twice a second.

Внимание само знает порядок токенов?: Does attention know the order of tokens by itself?
Да: порядок виден по тому, где стоит ток: Yes: the order shows in where a token stands
Нет: без позиционных кодировок перестано: No: without positional encodings, permuting the tokens doesn't change the output
Знает, но только для текста: It does, but only for text
В модели нет ни рекуррентности, ни свёрт: The model has no recurrence and no convolutions, so positions are added explicitly. In ACT these are 2D sinusoids, in Decision Transformer a step embedding, in Gemma RoPE.
Да, оно лишь меняет масштаб оценок: Yes, it only changes the scale of the scores
Нет: без него дисперсия q·k растёт как d: No: without it the variance of q·k grows as d_k, softmax saturates and the gradients almost vanish
Оно нужно только при маленьком d_k: It's only needed when d_k is small
В лаборатории при d_k = 256 без деления: In the lab, at d_k = 256 without division, all the weight went to one object. Dividing by 16 brought the scores back into a working range.
Восемь голов внимания в восемь раз дорож: Are eight attention heads eight times as expensive as one?
Нет: при d_k = d_model/h стоимость близк: No: with d_k = d_model/h the cost is close to that of one full-width head
Каждая голова работает в пространстве ши: Each head works in a space of width d_model/h. The heads look at different features, like “color” and “location” in the lab, and together cost almost as much as one.
Весь трансформер дорожает квадратично с: Does the whole transformer get quadratically more expensive with the number of tokens?
Нет: квадратичен только член внимания, п: No: only the attention term is quadratic; the projections and FFN grow linearly
По Vaswani, self-attention дешевле рекур: According to Vaswani et al., self-attention is cheaper than a recurrent layer as long as n < d. For π0, n ≈ 870 with d_model 2048 (our calculation). FlashAttention doesn't remove the quadratic FLOPs: it saves memory accesses.
KV-кэш ускоряет обучение и первый проход: Does the KV cache speed up training and the first pass?
Нет: он работает только на выводе и изба: No: it only works at inference and saves recomputing tokens that have already been processed
Он уменьшает число параметров модели: It reduces the number of model parameters
Проход по наблюдению у π0 так и стоит 32: π0's pass over the observation still costs 32 ms, and 46 together with the encoders. The gain is that the observation is computed once for 10 flow steps.

Поэтому π0-FAST тратит на пачку около 75: That's why π0-FAST spends about 750 ms per chunk, while π0 takes about 100 ms.
Частота управления равна частоте вывода: Is the control rate equal to the model's inference rate?
Нет: π0 даёт 50 Гц при выводе 73 мс за с: No: π0 gives 50 Hz with 73 ms inference thanks to chunks
Да, если есть KV-кэш: Yes, if there's a KV cache
Модель выдаёт 50 действий и перезапускае: The model outputs 50 actions and is rerun once every 0.5 s. Helix and GR00T N1 split a slow VLM (7–10 Hz) from a fast policy (120–200 Hz).
Трансформер всегда лучше свёрточной сети: Is a transformer always better than a convolutional network?
Нет: в RT-1, ACT и S1 Helix картинки код: No: in RT-1, ACT and Helix's S1 the images are encoded by a CNN, and in Octo a ResNet beats ViT when training from scratch on small data
Нет: CNN всегда лучше: No: a CNN is always better
ViT уступает ResNet на ImageNet без силь: ViT loses to ResNet on ImageNet without strong regularization and catches up with the best models only at 14–300 million images.
